_note: Seed registry of statutory references. EVERY seed entry is REQUIRES_VERIFICATION. A CA must check each against the official bare Act (https://incometaxindia.gov.in) and mark it VERIFIED in the app before it can appear in a reply. Summaries are short orientation notes, not statutory text. No judicial precedents are seeded: the CA adds verified precedents manually. No Income-tax Act, 2025 section numbers are seeded: the CA enters verified equivalents. v2: 'effective_from' and 'applies_to' on seed entries are the author's understanding and are part of what the CA must verify. Source links: official Income Tax Department pages where available (each page states the text version it reproduces); judgments link to the text on Indian Kanoon, a secondary (non-official) source. Nothing here is verified until a CA checks it.

entries.title: Cash credits
entries.summary: A sum credited in the books of the assessee for which no satisfactory explanation of nature and source is offered may be charged as income. For loans/borrowings, the proviso (inserted by Finance Act 2022) also requires the creditor's source of funds to be explained — verify the exact text and its applicability to the AY. Applies only to credits found in books maintained by the assessee; do not treat a bank statement alone as the assessee's books.

entries.title: Unexplained investments
entries.summary: Investments not recorded in books whose nature and source are not satisfactorily explained.

entries.title: Unexplained money, etc.
entries.summary: Money, bullion, jewellery or other valuable articles owned and not recorded in books, if not satisfactorily explained. Relevance to bank deposits depends on whether the deposit is recorded in books maintained by the assessee — examine the books first.

entries.title: Unexplained expenditure
entries.summary: Expenditure whose source is not satisfactorily explained.

entries.title: Tax on income referred to in sections 68 to 69D
entries.summary: Special rate (60%) on income referred to in ss.68–69D, with no deduction for expenditure/allowance and no set-off of losses against such income. Surcharge at 25% and cess apply — verify rates for the AY under the relevant Finance Act.
entries.applies_to: 60% rate applies from AY 2017-18 (verify amending Act and date)

entries.title: Inquiry before assessment
entries.summary: Power of the Assessing Officer to call for information, accounts and documents.

entries.title: Notice for scrutiny assessment
entries.summary: Notice for selection of a return for scrutiny; time limit for service is linked to the end of the financial year in which the return is filed — verify the exact limitation for the AY and the date of service.

entries.title: Scrutiny assessment order
entries.summary: Assessment after considering the evidence produced.

entries.title: Best judgment assessment
entries.summary: Assessment to the best of judgment on failure to comply with notices.

entries.title: Faceless assessment
entries.summary: Procedure for faceless assessment, including show-cause notice / draft order before variation prejudicial to the assessee — verify current procedural requirements.

entries.title: Reassessment
entries.summary: Notice for income escaping assessment and pre-notice procedure. Time limits and procedure changed by Finance Acts 2021 and 2024 — verify the version applicable to the date of notice.

entries.title: Restriction on cash receipts
entries.summary: No person shall receive ₹2,00,000 or more in cash from a person in a day, in respect of a single transaction, or in respect of transactions relating to one event or occasion (subject to exceptions). Penalty under s.271DA. Flag any single cash receipt ≥ ₹2,00,000.

entries.title: Mode of taking loans or deposits
entries.summary: Restriction on accepting loans/deposits/specified sums of ₹20,000 or more otherwise than by specified banking modes. Penalty under s.271D. Whether a partner's capital contribution is a 'loan or deposit' is a question of fact and law — CA judgement required.

entries.title: Penalty for under-reporting and misreporting
entries.summary: Penalty of 50% of tax payable on under-reported income; 200% where under-reporting is in consequence of misreporting. Initiation and levy are separate from assessment.

entries.title: Penalty on income referred to in ss.68–69D
entries.summary: Penalty of 10% of tax payable under s.115BBE(1)(i), subject to exceptions (e.g., income included in the return and tax paid). No s.270A penalty on the same income.

entries.title: Interest
entries.summary: Interest for default in furnishing return, in payment of advance tax, and for deferment of advance tax. NOT computed by NOTICE-MATE v1.

entries.title: Cash payments exceeding limit
entries.summary: Disallowance of expenditure paid otherwise than by specified modes above the prescribed threshold.

entries.title: Commencement of the Income-tax Act, 2025
entries.summary: The Income-tax Act, 2025 came into force on 1 April 2026 and introduces the 'tax year' concept. Verify the commencement notification and applicable provisions.

entries.title: Repeal of the 1961 Act and savings
entries.summary: Proceedings relating to periods before the 2025 Act may continue under the 1961 Act by virtue of the repeal and savings provisions. The CA must verify the exact provision and how it applies to the specific proceeding (assessment, reassessment, penalty, appeal).

entries.title: Remission or cessation of trading liability
entries.summary: Where a trading liability allowed earlier is remitted or ceases, the benefit may be deemed business income. Relevant where creditor balances are questioned; subsequent payment or confirmation of the liability bears on whether any cessation occurred — verify text and applicability.
entries.applies_to: Verify the version applicable to the AY

entries.title: Depreciation
entries.summary: Depreciation on assets owned and used for business; where an asset acquired in the year is put to use for less than 180 days in that year, the deduction is restricted to 50% of the prescribed rate — verify rates (Appendix I to the Rules) and the dates of use.
entries.applies_to: Verify the version applicable to the AY

entries.provision: CIT v. Orissa Corporation (P) Ltd., (1986) 159 ITR 78 (SC)
entries.title: Cash credits — creditors' particulars furnished
entries.summary: Decided 19-03-1986 (CA Nos. 1379–1380 of 1974). Commonly cited for the position that where the assessee furnishes names, addresses and particulars of creditors and the Revenue does not pursue the inquiry, the assessee may be regarded as having discharged its burden. Read the judgment before relying on it.
entries.applies_to: Fact-dependent; check later decisions on s.68 and the 2022 proviso

entries.provision: Kale Khan Mohammad Hanif v. CIT, (1963) 50 ITR 1 (SC)
entries.title: Onus to explain the source of cash credits
entries.summary: Decided 08-02-1963. Commonly cited for the position that the onus of proving the source of a sum received is on the assessee and, absent proof, it may be treated as income. Generally relied on by the Revenue — read before use.
